# ⚡ 2-TEK Lighting MVC: Production Mode

Binary fully compiled to bit code (native C++20 -O3 machine code).

## Start Command

```bash
cxvm start dist/cat-store
```

Usage with custom binary:

```bash
cxvm start {binarypath}
```

Alternative engine alias:

```bash
cxvm light start dist/cat-store
cxvm light start {binarypath}
```

Or run standalone native binary directly:

```bash
./dist/cat-store
```
